Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-unit-outcome

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-unit-outcome defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
validated ValidatedThe verification window meets the applicable versioned verification criteria for its service context, including provider authentication, location and client presence where required. This factual verification result is not billable, payable or payer-approved status.
partial PartialOnly part of the verification window is supported under the applicable verification criteria; no billing conclusion is implied.
unsupported UnsupportedThe available evidence does not support verification of the window under the applicable criteria; no billing conclusion is implied.
unobserved UnobservedNo observation supports the verification window; no billing conclusion is implied.
